title: EEG biomarkers can predict early-stage Alzheimer's disease and correlate with intracerebral pathology: a multimodal machine learning study.
summary: Resting-state EEG features and ML distinguish early Alzheimer disease from healthy controls; test-set multimodal PSD/microstate AUC is reported alongside correlations with intracerebral pathology/cognition. The result is cohort-specific. The result is reported in the Alzheimer's Research & Therapy. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
